scope: Stage 2 editorial and product-intent corrections; draft ads only

decisions.1703: Use separately confirmed Nissan Rogue compatibility. Common X-Trail manual intent remains in 1707; no invented difference between new engines.
decisions.1949: Use the confirmed 2021 year for this offer; the other retained offer has restyling compatibility beginning in 2022.
decisions.orderedNegatives: Exclude component-first queries without banning a complete door with glass or bumper with skirt when the whole part is named first. Do not minus the opposite side.
decisions.similarParts: Keep separate offers and all five autotargeting categories. Unspecified part variants may still share demand; exact article filters and exclusions protect explicit article queries.
decisions.withinGroupOverlaps: Generic and detailed keys selecting the same single product are intentional. Do not apply cross-minuses that exclude the same product from its own group.
decisions.articleNormalization: Direct represents the hyphenated article X03-41330022 as two tokens in a negative phrase. Preserve the normalized live spelling x03 41330022.
